website.title: This website
paragraphs: This website doesn't use cookies, contains no advertising or tracking tools and collects no data through forms.
A small entry is kept in your browser only to remember that you closed the language suggestion bar; it is never sent to us.
The hosting provider (Vercel) may keep short-lived server logs for security and operation.

deleteAccount.title: Deleting your account
deleteAccount.text: You can permanently delete your account at any time. Here's how:
steps: In the app, tap Profile → Settings → Account → Delete account.
Confirm. Your account, profile, the data linked to you and the messages you sent are permanently deleted.
If you can't get into the app, write to {email} from your registered email address; we'll complete your request within 30 days at the latest.
deleteAccount.tip: Before deleting, you can get a copy with Settings → Account → "Download my data".
deleteAccount.retentionTitle: What gets deleted, and what stays for how long
deleteAccount.retentionSource: From the "How long we keep it" section of the privacy policy.
